reference_repair.finding: Historical Julia genuinely implements the native bit-packed phenotype-specific3x3 contingency popcounts and Float32 approximate score. Preserve arithmetic verbatim. Its gridY uses SNP count instead of native padded SNP count; named measurement aligns gridY128, a P1 geometry difference with unchanged computed outputs. Full-output checking later exposed Julia typemax(Float32)=Inf versus native finite FLT_MAX; explicit floatmax sentinel repair preserves native output encoding, not a changed genotype computation.

contract.scope: One planted synthetic genetic interaction, both partial final packs; not clinical association calibration or general statistical validity. Source gamma is a declared Stirling-like log-factorial approximation, not exact log-gamma.
